fusions.name: Rind Rasp
fusions.desc: Gnaws at the target, dealing 8 damage and leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Flung Refuse
fusions.desc: Flings rubbish that deals 12 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Gnawing Horde
fusions.desc: Calls a swarm that fights beside you for 15 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds against enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Scavenged Strength
fusions.desc: When you gain health, your damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
